archetypes.name: merge-loop-correctness
archetypes.rationale: The fix changes terminal versus retry routing in the ship merge loop.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the CI_NOT_READY routing in ship.py. Check that admin-fallback-enabled runs never bail to review-required while CI is pending. Check that --no-admin-fallback still bails when reviewDecision is REVIEW_REQUIRED. Verify the new tests would fail on the old behavior and pass on the intended behavior. Cite every finding with path and line evidence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
